journeys.name: Add a Standard to Organisation
journeys.description: A user searches for a standard, chooses versions, confirms, and completes the addition to their organisation.

journeys.name: Assessment Opportunity Finder
journeys.description: A (potential) assessor browses, filters, and expresses interest in assessment opportunities, including navigating to standard details.

journeys.name: Manage Organisation Profile
journeys.description: A user views and edits detailed organisation information such as address, email, phone, website, and contacts.

journeys.name: Complete an End-Point Assessment Application
journeys.description: A user starts from the applications dashboard, chooses to apply, selects a standard, completes the application sections, and submits.

journeys.name: Create and Confirm a Certificate
journeys.description: A user initiates certificate creation and proceeds through version selection, declaration, grading, date, delivery options, address steps, and final confirmation.

journeys.name: Apply for Withdrawal of a Standard
journeys.description: A user initiates a withdrawal, selects the type, and proceeds to view submitted withdrawal applications.

journeys.name: Organisational Registration (New User Onboarding)
journeys.description: A new user creates an account and finds or creates their organisation before entering the system dashboard.
